newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan mulls easing stocks' daily seven pct limit.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan mulls easing stocks' daily seven pct limit.

text.p: Taiwan Finance Minister Paul Chiu said on Tuesday he did not rule out the possibility of gradually loosening rules that limit a share price's daily movement to seven percent up or down.

The ministry would review the stock movement restrictions within three months and may ease the seven percent limit as part of the government's drive to liberalise and internationalise the local bourse, Chiu told state television.
The existing stock limits were aimed at curbing speculation and stabilising the island's financial markets.
Taiwan's top economic planning agency has proposed scrapping such limits to liberalise the stock market and comply with international practice.
On Tuesday, the benchmark stock index closed 37.56 points or 0.39 percent lower at 9,555.98 on a record turnover of T$262 billion.
